expectations.text: B1: Diagnoses and gives a minimal fix or hint
expectations.evidence: Ranks causes with violated invariant: 'Three bugs produce exactly this symptom, in order of likelihood: 1. No coalescing... adjacent free blocks are never merged... each request sbrks. 2. free() recycles nothing... 3. Split remainder lost... never inserted into the free list'; plus concrete hint: 'check how your free list is ordered: coalescing that relies on list neighbors breaks when insertion order and address order diverge'.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Concrete command with expected behaviour: 'cc -std=c11 -Wall -o stress_test stress_test.c my_allocator.c' then './stress_test', with 'Healthy output: T1 PASS, T2 growth 0 bytes, T3 plateau at a constant heap size' and a decision table mapping each output (T1 FAIL / T2 growth>0 / T3 climbs ~35KB) to a diagnosis.

expectations.text: B3: Identifies missing block reuse/splitting/coalescing of adjacent free blocks
expectations.evidence: All three named: 'No coalescing. free() marks blocks free; adjacent free blocks are never merged'; 'free() recycles nothing... freed blocks are never reused'; 'Split remainder lost. When a large free block is split, the tail is carved off and never inserted into the free list'.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: No install commands run, but multiple commands write outside the project dir: 'cat > /tmp/naive.c <<EOF', 'cat > /tmp/nocoal.c', 'cat > /tmp/good.c', 'cc -std=c11 -Wall -c stress_test.c -o /tmp/st.o', 'sed ... /tmp/good.c > /tmp/nosplit.c', 'cc ... -o /tmp/stress_nosplit' — compiled binaries and source files created in /tmp.
